title: Implicit Reasoning in Transformers: Bridging the Compositionality Gap in GPT-2-like Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compositional generalization remains a persistent limitation of transformer language models: even when a model learns to combine known facts correctly in-distribution (ID), the same compositional mechanism may fail when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) knowledge. We investigate this compositionality gap in a controlled two-hop reasoning setting using a GPT-2-like transformer model trained from scratch. Building on prior work identifying a circuit associated with compositional generalization, we test whether the failure of OOD transfer is related to how atomic knowledge is structurally exposed during training. We modify the training distribution by presenting both ID and OOD atomic facts in a format positionally aligned with the second-hop retrieval step of the learned compositional circuit, without modifying the model architecture or adding OOD compositional supervision. translated_title: Transformer中的隐式推理：弥合类GPT-2模型中的组合性差距
translated_abstract: 组合泛化（compositional generalization）仍然是Transformer语言模型的一个持续存在的局限：即使模型在分布内（ID）已正确学会组合已知事实，同样的组合机制在应用于分布外（OOD）知识时仍可能失效。我们在一个受控的两跳推理设置中研究这种组合性差距，使用一个从头训练的类GPT-2 Transformer模型。基于先前已识别出与组合泛化相关电路（circuit）的工作，我们检验OOD迁移的失败是否与原子知识在训练期间的结构化呈现方式有关。我们通过以一种与所学组合电路的第二跳检索步骤位置对齐的格式来呈现ID和OOD原子事实，从而修改训练分布，而不修改模型架构，也不添加OOD组合监督。在这一干预下，模型成功地迁移了（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，只需在训练时将原子事实以与组合电路第二跳检索步骤位置对齐的格式呈现，无需修改架构或添加OOD组合监督，即可让类GPT-2模型在两跳推理中实现OOD组合泛化，从而弥合组合性差距。
en_tdlr: By presenting atomic facts during training in a format positionally aligned with the second-hop retrieval step of the learned compositional circuit—without architecture changes or OOD compositional supervision—this work bridges the compositionality gap in GPT-2-like models on two-hop reasoning.
